identity.name: South China Morning Post
identity.description: A Hong Kong English-language newspaper and digital publisher covering China, Asia and international affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Owned by Alibaba Group since 2016. Alibaba's commercial interests in China create structural pressure on editorial independence, though the newsroom retains professional reporting standards.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Professional newsroom with original reporting, but Alibaba ownership and China-market exposure create credible self-censorship risk on sensitive topics.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Left-Center but factual reporting Mixed; China coverage is often more restrained than Western outlets.

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage is market and corporate focused, reflecting Hong Kong's financial-press tradition.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames China and regional affairs with attention to Beijing's sensitivities and Hong Kong's commercial role.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting Mixed and credibility Medium; strong original reporting coexists with ownership-related constraints.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting Mixed; credibility Medium (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Hong Kong/China-facing business and political voice. Provides detailed China coverage from inside the region, but with structural caution on topics sensitive to Beijing and Alibaba.

selectionRationale: Adds an important Hong Kong/China perspective and regional access, with explicit ownership and reliability caveats.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained, but MBFC suggests Left-Center. Ownership risk should be reviewed before treating SCMP as a neutral China source. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
